key_insight: For this commercial PV-plus-battery case, simple day-ahead MPC nearly matches the best possible cost savings, while the tested RL controller underperforms a no-storage baseline.
engineering_relevance: For real commercial battery dispatch under TOU tariffs, a low-complexity forecast-based controller can deliver most of the economic value without the complexity of perfect-foresight optimization or deep RL.
method: MILP with perfect foresight as an upper-bound benchmark
MPC using a day-ahead persistence forecast
Soft actor-critic RL trained with causal information only
evidence_signal: On a full-year 2023 commercial dataset, MILP reduced annual cost by 24.6% versus no storage, and persistence-based MPC achieved 99.2% of that benchmark.
watch_item: The RL result is specific to the chosen SAC setup and limited observability; different reward design, features, or training data could change performance, but this study shows such methods are not automatically competitive in deployment.
paper_title: Comparative Evaluation of MILP, MPC, and Reinforcement Learning for Commercial Battery Dispatch Under Time-of-Use Tariffs
